question: The bottom-bar slider differs only by timing: default build lacks .dx-bottom-bar-slider-appear, loading build has no slider. The clone's logic is the compiled one. How do we close these two differences?
evidence: TST order (capture/runtime-HomeFeed.json): SynchAppContext t=3799, screen data actions 5034-5326, AfterInitialize 7211, Sync_Info_GetMain 7961, so OnApplicationReady_BottomBarSlider ran about 2 s after the screen rendered (UBTConnect.controller.js:15318-15332). The first-screen transition event (duration 0) had already fired, so the slider was appended by BottomBarSlider_ForceRefresh with no duration: --dx-bottom-bar-transition-duration 'undefinedms' (dom/default.html slider line). That makes 'animation: dx-bottom-bar-slider-appear var(--dx-bottom-bar-transition-duration)' invalid (UBTConnectLibrary.UBTConnectLibrary.css:1802-1803), so no animationend fires and -appear stays. Parity serves the mocks with latency=0 (parity_check.cjs:533), so the clone's app start ends at about 160 ms, before the first screen mounts at about 430 ms. The first transition (0 ms) then appends the slider, its 0 ms animation ends and -appear is removed. With the app's default mock latency (600 ms) the clone gives the captured markup exactly: slider added at 1340 ms with undefinedms, -appear kept (Playwright probe, 2026-10-15). In the loading capture the calls were held. SynchAppContext times out after the UBT_AppManager default of 10 s (UBT_AppManager.controller.js:8579; runtime getEffectiveTimeoutForServerCall, applicationDefaultTimeout 0 in moduleinfo.json; XHR timeout gives CommunicationException 'The connection has timed out' in OutSystems.js). SynchAppContextInternal catches it and returns the empty Config (UBT_AppManager.controller.js:5103-5113), so the slider is installed about 10 s in. UBTConnect data actions time out at 20 s (UBTConnect.controller.js:18597), which is the accepted CAPTURE-LOADING-FETCH-TIMEOUT state. The clone has no request timeout, so its app start never ends under latency=infinite. Parity photographs the loading state 1.5 s after load (parity_check.cjs:537).
mcp: not consulted (no MCP in this task); facts from TST compiled code, runtime sources and the capture
options: A: accept both as capture-timing artifacts (exemptions: class .dx-bottom-bar-slider-appear on div.dx-bottom-bar-slider in default; structure of div.dx-bottom-bar-slider in loading); no code change

B: port the OutSystems server-request timeout into callAction (module defaults from the compiled controllers: UBT_AppManager 10 s, UBTConnect 20 s, UBTConnectLibrary 10 s; CommunicationException on timeout) as a foundation change; parity would also need a loading wait of 20 s or more (skill change); it would also retire CAPTURE-LOADING-FETCH-TIMEOUT
C: make the parity mocks answer the app-start calls with the capture's timings (per-call delay from runtime-*.json; skill or mock change)
recommend: A now for parity; raise B separately as a foundation item because a request timeout is real OutSystems behaviour that production needs
answer: A (user, 2026-10-15): timing artifacts of the capture; narrow exemptions SLIDER-APPEAR-TIMING (class, default) and SLIDER-LOADING-TIMEOUT (structure, loading); porting the OutSystems request timeouts into callAction is a foundation backlog item
